Family: Fish (any). Could be: Salmon, Trout, Whitefish (white-fleshed fish), Cod, Pollock / saithe, Haddock, Hake, Whiting, Flatfish (plaice, sole, flounder), Hoki, Tilapia, Catfish, Tuna, Mackerel, Sardine / pilchard, Herring, Anchovy, Menhaden, Sprat, Capelin. Protein carryover: high.
- [Fish oil](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/fish-oil/): Oil extracted from fish; mostly lipid, with lower but not zero protein content; the exact species is not stated on the label. Family: Fish (any). Could be: Salmon, Trout, Whitefish (white-fleshed fish), Cod, Pollock / saithe, Haddock, Hake, Whiting, Flatfish (plaice, sole, flounder), Hoki, Tilapia, Catfish, Tuna, Mackerel, Sardine / pilchard, Herring, Anchovy, Menhaden, Sprat, Capelin. Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Hydrolyzed fish protein](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/hydrolyzed-fish-protein/): Fish protein broken down into smaller peptides; the degree of hydrolysis varies by product; the exact species is not stated on the label. Family: Fish (any). Could be: Salmon, Trout, Whitefish (white-fleshed fish), Cod, Pollock / saithe, Haddock, Hake, Whiting, Flatfish (plaice, sole, flounder), Hoki, Tilapia, Catfish, Tuna, Mackerel, Sardine / pilchard, Herring, Anchovy, Menhaden, Sprat, Capelin. Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Fish by-products](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/fish-by-products/): Non-muscle fish parts from species that are not stated. Family: Fish (any). Could be: Salmon, Tuna, Whitefish (white-fleshed fish), Cod, Pollock / saithe, Herring, Sardine / pilchard, Anchovy, Mackerel. Protein carryover: high.
- [Ocean fish](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/ocean-fish/): Fish from the sea whose species is not stated. Family: Fish (any). Could be: Salmon, Tuna, Whitefish (white-fleshed fish), Cod, Pollock / saithe, Herring, Sardine / pilchard, Anchovy, Mackerel, Menhaden. Protein carryover: high.

- [Hydrolyzed salmon protein](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/hydrolyzed-salmon-protein/): Salmon protein broken down into smaller peptides; the degree of hydrolysis varies by product. Family: Salmon, Fish (any). Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Tuna](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/tuna/): Tuna meat or flesh, which carries tuna protein. Family: Tuna, Fish (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Whitefish](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/whitefish/): Whitefish meat or flesh, which carries whitefish protein. Family: Whitefish (white-fleshed fish), Fish (any). Could be: Cod, Pollock / saithe, Haddock, Hake, Whiting, Flatfish (plaice, sole, flounder), Hoki, Tilapia, Catfish. Protein carryover: high.
- [Menhaden meal](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/menhaden-meal/): Rendered and dried menhaden tissue concentrated into a protein meal. Family: Menhaden, Fish (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Cod liver oil](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/cod-liver-oil/): Oil from cod liver containing vitamins A and D and omega-3 fatty acids; protein content is low but not zero. Family: Cod, Whitefish (white-fleshed fish), Fish (any). Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Krill oil](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/krill-oil/): Oil extracted from krill; mostly lipid, with lower but not zero protein content. Family: Shellfish (crustaceans, molluscs). Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Green-lipped mussel](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/green-lipped-mussel/): Dried New Zealand green-lipped mussel, a source of omega-3 fatty acids and glycosaminoglycans that carries shellfish protein. Family: Shellfish (crustaceans, molluscs). Protein carryover: high.

### Unnamed animal sources

- [Meat](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/meat/): Non-specific meat from one or more animal species that the label does not name. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Lamb / sheep, Chicken, Turkey, Duck, Goat, Venison (deer), Rabbit, Horse, Poultry (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Meat and animal derivatives](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/meat-and-animal-derivatives/): EU category term for meat and animal by-products whose species are not named unless declared, for example "of which chicken 4%". Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Lamb / sheep, Chicken, Turkey, Duck, Goat, Venison (deer), Rabbit, Horse, Poultry (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Meat meal](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/meat-meal/): Rendered meal from mammal tissue whose species is not stated; AAFCO excludes poultry from this term. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Lamb / sheep, Goat, Horse, Venison (deer). Protein carryover: high.
- [Meat by-products](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/meat-by-products/): Non-muscle mammal parts such as organs from species that are not stated; AAFCO excludes poultry from this term. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Lamb / sheep, Goat, Venison (deer). Protein carryover: high.
- [Meat by-product meal](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/meat-by-product-meal/): Rendered meal from animal parts other than muscle meat, from species that are not stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Lamb / sheep, Goat, Venison (deer), Poultry (any), Chicken. Protein carryover: high.
- [Animal protein](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/animal-protein/): Non-specific animal protein whose source species is not stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Lamb / sheep, Chicken, Turkey, Duck, Poultry (any), Fish (any), Egg, Dairy (milk). Protein carryover: high.
- [Hydrolyzed animal protein](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/hydrolyzed-animal-protein/): Animal protein broken into smaller peptides whose source species is not stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Chicken, Poultry (any), Fish (any). Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Animal fat](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/animal-fat/): Rendered fat from animal species that are not stated; mostly lipid, with lower but not zero protein content. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Lamb / sheep, Chicken, Poultry (any), Fish (any). Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Tallow](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/tallow/): Rendered fat usually from cattle or sheep; species is not always stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Lamb / sheep, Goat. Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Animal digest](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/animal-digest/): Animal tissue broken down by enzymes or heat and used for palatability; source species is often not stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Chicken, Poultry (any), Fish (any), Lamb / sheep. Protein carryover: high.
- [Liver](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/liver/): Liver whose source species is not stated on the label. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Lamb / sheep, Chicken, Turkey, Poultry (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Animal plasma](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/animal-plasma/): Dried blood plasma whose source species is not stated. Family: none. Could be: Pork, Beef, Chicken, Poultry (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Blood meal](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/blood-meal/): Dried blood whose source species is often not stated. Family: none. Could be: Pork, Beef, Chicken, Poultry (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Gelatin](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/gelatin/): Processed collagen used for texture; source species is often not stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Fish (any), Chicken. Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Collagen](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/collagen/): Collagen protein, often hydrolyzed; source species is often not stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Fish (any), Chicken. Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Bone broth](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/bone-broth/): Liquid made by simmering bones whose species is not stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Chicken, Pork, Turkey, Poultry (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Broth](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/broth/): Cooking liquid from animal tissue whose species is not stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Chicken, Pork, Turkey, Fish (any), Poultry (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Bone meal](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/bone-meal/): Ground bone used mainly as a calcium and phosphorus source; species is often not stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Chicken, Poultry (any). Protein carryover: reduced.

### Egg, dairy and insects

- [Egg](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/egg/): Whole hen's egg, which carries egg white and yolk proteins. Family: Egg. Protein carryover: high.
- [Dried egg product](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/dried-egg-product/): Dried whole egg or egg parts, which carries egg proteins. Family: Egg. Protein carryover: high.
- [Eggshell membrane](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/eggshell-membrane/): The inner membrane of the eggshell, a source of collagen and glucosamine that may carry egg protein. Family: Egg. Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Milk](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/milk/): Cow's milk, which carries milk proteins such as casein and whey proteins. Family: Dairy (milk). Protein carryover: high.
- [Whey](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/whey/): The liquid part of milk left after cheesemaking, which carries whey proteins. Family: Dairy (milk). Protein carryover: high.
- [Casein](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/casein/): The main protein of milk, sometimes added as caseinate. Family: Dairy (milk). Protein carryover: high.
- [Cheese](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/cheese/): Cheese made from milk, which carries milk proteins. Family: Dairy (milk). Protein carryover: high.
- [Lactose](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/lactose/): Milk sugar; purified lactose carries little milk protein, but traces are possible. Family: none. Could be: Dairy (milk). Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Black soldier fly larvae meal](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/black-soldier-fly-larvae-meal/): Dried and ground black soldier fly larvae, an insect protein meal. Family: Insect protein. Protein carryover: high.

### Grains

- [Wheat](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/wheat/): Wheat grain, which carries wheat proteins including gluten. Family: Wheat, Gluten grains (wheat, barley, rye), Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Wheat flour](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/wheat-flour/): Milled wheat, which carries wheat proteins including gluten. Family: Wheat, Gluten grains (wheat, barley, rye), Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Wheat gluten](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/wheat-gluten/): Concentrated wheat protein (gluten). Family: Wheat, Gluten grains (wheat, barley, rye), Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Corn](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/corn/): Corn (maize) grain, which carries corn proteins. Family: Corn (maize), Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Corn meal](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/corn-meal/): Ground corn, which carries corn proteins. Family: Corn (maize), Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Corn gluten meal](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/corn-gluten-meal/): Concentrated corn protein left after starch extraction; corn "gluten" is not wheat gluten. Family: Corn (maize), Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Rice](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/rice/): Rice grain, which carries rice proteins. Family: Rice, Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Brewers rice](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/brewers-rice/): Broken rice fragments left from rice milling. Family: Rice, Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Brown rice](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/brown-rice/): Whole-grain rice with the bran layer, which carries rice proteins. Family: Rice, Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Rice bran](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/rice-bran/): Outer layer of the rice grain, used for fiber and fat. Family: Rice, Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Barley](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/barley/): Barley grain, which carries barley proteins including gluten-type proteins. Family: Barley, Gluten grains (wheat, barley, rye), Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Oats](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/oats/): Oat grain; oats may be cross-contaminated with gluten grains unless certified. Family: Oats, Cereal grains (any). Could be: Gluten grains (wheat, barley, rye). Protein carryover: high.
- [Sorghum](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/sorghum/): Sorghum grain, a gluten-free cereal. Family: Sorghum, Cereal grains (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Cereals](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/cereals/): Non-specific cereal grains; the label does not say which grains are used. Family: Cereal grains (any). Could be: Wheat, Corn (maize), Rice, Barley, Oats, Rye, Sorghum, Millet, Gluten grains (wheat, barley, rye). Protein carryover: high.

### Legumes, potatoes and other starches

- [Peas](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/peas/): Peas, a pulse that carries pea proteins. Family: Pea, Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Pea protein](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/pea-protein/): Concentrated pea protein. Family: Pea, Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Pea starch](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/pea-starch/): Starch extracted from peas; some pea protein can remain. Family: Pea, Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Pea fiber](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/pea-fiber/): Fiber from pea hulls; some pea protein can remain. Family: Pea, Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Lentils](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/lentils/): Lentils, a pulse that carries lentil proteins. Family: Lentil, Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Chickpeas](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/chickpeas/): Chickpeas, a pulse that carries chickpea proteins. Family: Chickpea, Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Soybean meal](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/soybean-meal/): Ground soybeans left after oil extraction, a concentrated soy protein source. Family: Soy, Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Soy protein isolate](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/soy-protein-isolate/): Concentrated soy protein. Family: Soy, Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: high.
- [Hydrolyzed soy protein](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/hydrolyzed-soy-protein/): Soy protein broken down into smaller peptides; used in some veterinary hydrolyzed diets. Family: Soy, Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Potato](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/potato/): Potato, used as a carbohydrate source. Family: Potato. Protein carryover: high.
- [Sweet potato](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/sweet-potato/): Sweet potato, used as a carbohydrate and fiber source. Family: Sweet potato. Protein carryover: high.
- [Tapioca](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/tapioca/): Starch from cassava root; protein content is low. Family: Tapioca / cassava. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Alfalfa](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/alfalfa/): Dried alfalfa (lucerne) leaves and stems, a legume forage used for fiber and nutrients. Family: none. Could be: Legumes / pulses (any). Protein carryover: reduced.

### Plant oils and fibers

- [Sunflower oil](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/sunflower-oil/): Oil pressed from sunflower seeds, a source of omega-6 linoleic acid. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Canola oil](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/canola-oil/): Oil from canola (low-erucic rapeseed), a source of omega-6 and omega-3 fatty acids. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Flaxseed](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/flaxseed/): Flaxseed, a source of fiber and omega-3 alpha-linolenic acid. Family: Flaxseed (linseed). Protein carryover: high.
- [Vegetable oil](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/vegetable-oil/): Plant oil whose source plant is not stated; refined oils carry very little protein. Family: none. Could be: Soy, Corn (maize), Peanut, Coconut, Flaxseed (linseed). Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Algal oil](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/algal-oil/): Oil from microalgae, a source of DHA omega-3. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Powdered cellulose](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/powdered-cellulose/): Purified plant cellulose used as insoluble fiber. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Beet pulp](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/beet-pulp/): Fiber left after sugar extraction from sugar beets. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Fructooligosaccharides](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/fructooligosaccharides/): Short-chain fructose fibers used as a prebiotic. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Psyllium husk](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/psyllium/): Husk of psyllium seeds, a soluble fiber. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.

### Amino acids and supplements

- [Taurine](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/taurine/): An amino sulfonic acid that is essential in the diet of cats. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [DL-methionine](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/dl-methionine/): A source of the essential amino acid methionine. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [L-carnitine](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/l-carnitine/): A nutrient involved in fat metabolism, added as a supplement. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Glucosamine](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/glucosamine/): A joint supplement usually made from shellfish shells or by fermentation; the source is rarely stated. Family: none. Could be: Shellfish (crustaceans, molluscs). Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Chondroitin sulfate](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/chondroitin-sulfate/): A joint supplement extracted from animal cartilage whose species is rarely stated. Family: none. Could be: Beef, Pork, Chicken, Poultry (any), Fish (any). Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Choline chloride](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/choline-chloride/): A source of choline, an essential nutrient. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Menadione nicotinamide bisulfite](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/menadione-nicotinamide-bisulfite/): A synthetic source of vitamin K activity. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Alpha-lipoic acid](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/alpha-lipoic-acid/): An antioxidant used in some supplements and foods. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Brewers dried yeast](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/brewers-dried-yeast/): Dried yeast from brewing, a source of protein and B vitamins; may carry traces of barley. Family: Yeast. Could be: Barley. Protein carryover: high.
- [Yeast extract](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/yeast-extract/): Soluble yeast contents used for flavour and nutrients. Family: Yeast. Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Dried fermentation products](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/dried-fermentation-products/): Dried microbial fermentation products whose organisms or media are not stated. Family: none. Could be: Yeast, Dairy (milk). Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Yucca schidigera extract](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/yucca-extract/): Extract of the Yucca schidigera plant, used to reduce stool odour. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.

### Preservatives and antioxidants

- [Mixed tocopherols](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/mixed-tocopherols/): Natural vitamin E compounds used to keep fats from going rancid, often from vegetable oils. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Rosemary extract](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/rosemary-extract/): Rosemary extract used as a natural antioxidant. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Citric acid](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/citric-acid/): An acid used to preserve fats and adjust acidity. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [BHA](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/bha/): Butylated hydroxyanisole, a synthetic antioxidant preservative. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [BHT](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/bht/): Butylated hydroxytoluene, a synthetic antioxidant preservative. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Ethoxyquin](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/ethoxyquin/): A synthetic antioxidant preservative, also used in fish meal. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [TBHQ](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/tbhq/): Tertiary butylhydroquinone, a synthetic antioxidant preservative. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Potassium sorbate](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/potassium-sorbate/): A mould inhibitor used in moist foods and treats. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Sodium benzoate](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/sodium-benzoate/): Benzoic acid or its salt, a preservative to which cats are sensitive. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Propylene glycol](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/propylene-glycol/): A humectant used in some semi-moist dog foods and treats. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.

### Flavors, colors and thickeners

- [Natural flavor](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/natural-flavor/): Non-specific flavouring that may be derived from animal or plant sources. Family: none. Could be: Chicken, Turkey, Duck, Poultry (any), Beef, Pork, Lamb / sheep, Fish (any), Salmon, Tuna, Dairy (milk), Egg, Yeast, Wheat, Soy, Corn (maize). Protein carryover: unknown.
- [Hydrolyzed vegetable protein](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/hydrolyzed-vegetable-protein/): Plant protein broken down into a savory flavouring; the plant is not always stated. Family: none. Could be: Soy, Wheat, Corn (maize), Pea. Protein carryover: reduced.
- [Carrageenan](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/carrageenan/): A thickener extracted from red seaweed, common in wet foods. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Guar gum](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/guar-gum/): A thickener from guar beans. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Caramel color](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/caramel-color/): Caramelized sugar used as a brown colour. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Titanium dioxide](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/titanium-dioxide/): A white mineral pigment used as a colour. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Red 40](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/red-40/): A synthetic red food dye. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.

### Plants with species notes

- [Garlic](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/garlic/): Garlic or garlic powder, an Allium plant. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Onion](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/onion/): Onion or onion powder, an Allium vegetable. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Grapes](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/grapes/): Grapes or grape by-products. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Cocoa](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/cocoa/): Cocoa or chocolate, which contains theobromine and caffeine. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Hops](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/hops/): Hop flowers, used in brewing. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Macadamia nuts](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/macadamia-nuts/): Macadamia nuts, a tree nut. Family: Tree nuts. Protein carryover: high.
- [Xylitol](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/xylitol/): A sugar alcohol sweetener. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
- [Pumpkin](https://isler404.github.io/apps/pawfood/ingredients/pumpkin/): Pumpkin or winter squash, used as a vegetable and fiber source. Family: none. Protein carryover: minimal.
